name: Vital Signs: Emergency Department
detailed_description:
Play a doctor in Vital Signs: Emergency Department and challenge your medical knowledge to help treat a wide array of cases who come into the ER. Unlike medical school everybody can enroll in Vital Signs with nothing down and as little as a commitment of 30 minutes or less!

Reach a diagnosis by selecting from a wide range of tests and prescribe medications or other treatments to give your patients the best possible care. However, remain vigilant and flexible! Your decisions and how you handle the influx of cases who come in during your shift will decide who gets the care they need and who misses out!

You completed the scenarios offered in the main game and have seen all nine patients. Naturally, you reached the best ideal care vs. improper care scores that are possible in Vital Signs: Emergency Department – so what now?

A life in the day of an ER doctor is almost never complete, and if you think you are capable of doing more, check out our nine additional content packs that are available for download on Steam. These content packs will give you access to more scenarios and more patients so you can get back into the ER and save lives. What are you waiting for, doctor?

KEY FEATURES

Two scenarios

9 patient cases

Add more patient cases and scenarios with downloadable content

Plays in under 30 minutes

Scoring based on ideal care vs. improper care
